title: What Can a Custom Hook Return?

blocks.content: Course: React Hooks: Level Up Your First Web App
What Can a Custom Hook Return?
A custom hook can return anything the caller needs:

items: Objects work well when there are several values to return.
Arrays work well when the caller wants to rename the values (the same way useState() does).

blocks.content: The real motivation for custom hooks becomes clear when you see them solving a problem you've already faced.
